It is also known as 'Marianna' or 'Mariaggia' (when played with open cards). The defining feature is the 'Marriage' (Mariaccio)â€”a King and Knight of the same suitâ€”which grants bonus points. It is a game of high targets, usually requiring 250 points to win, making it a longer and more tactical experience than standard Briscola.
Derived from the merging of Briscola mechanics with the 'Marriage' (King-Queen) bonuses of the Mariagespiel family.

Two players. Five cards are dealt to each player; the eleventh card is placed face up on the table to determine the trump suit. The remaining stock is placed face down across the face-up trump. The non-dealer leads to the first trick.
40 cards. Ranking: Ace, 3, King, Knight, Jack, 7, 6, 5, 4, 2.
